help:
Praxis runs your declared commands.

  praxis list [--all] [--json]
  praxis show NAME
  praxis plan NAME [ARGS] [--plain|--json]
  praxis run NAME [--yes] [--non-interactive] [ARGS]
  praxis doctor [NAME [ARGS]]
  praxis completions fish|bash|zsh

choiceError.message: mode expects one of debug, release, two words
